items.title: Claude Opus 5.5
items.title_zh: Claude Opus 5.5 发布
items.summary: Anthropic presents Claude Opus 5.5 as leading in agentic coding and knowledge work, and says it costs 40% less to run than Opus 5 on typical workloads.

items.title: IndustryLLM: Failure-Driven LLM Training for Industrial Procurement
items.title_zh: IndustryLLM：面向工业采购的失败驱动 LLM 训练
items.summary: Alibaba presents IndustryLLM, an open-weight 35B-parameter industrial model built on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base and trained with a failure-driven continued-pretraining and supervised fine-tuning recipe on a roughly 100B-token corpus. Offline procurement-query structuring improves by 2.97 exact-match points, while production A/B tests report 4.25% higher GMV, 8.3% more satisfied inquiries and latency falling from 6-7 s to 1.5 s.

items.title: Vestrum: Improving Agent Harnesses by Adapting Their Verification, Structure and Memory
items.title_zh: Vestrum：通过适配验证、结构与记忆改进智能体框架
items.summary: Vestrum turns failures in execution traces into scoped changes to an agent harness's verification, retrieval, decomposition and knowledge synthesis without training the task model, while a persistent lessons file informs later proposals. Frozen harnesses improve held-out performance, including UltraHorizon from 47.6 to 59.8 over GAM and Terminal-Bench 4 Hard from 63.7% to 70.3% of checks over Claude Code at 1.03x test cost.

items.title: DolphinBench: Mapping the Pareto Frontier of Agent Memory
items.title_zh: DolphinBench：绘制智能体记忆的帕累托前沿
items.summary: DolphinBench evaluates memory through an agent's task completion rather than conversational question answering, with three knowledge-work personas of roughly 500k tokens each and 200 tasks per persona verified to succeed with the relevant history and fail without it. It requires every evaluation to report total cost and latency alongside accuracy.

items.title: AutoResearch at Production Scale: Failure Modes and a Multi-Agent Framework
items.title_zh: 生产规模下的自动化研究：失败模式与多智能体框架
items.summary: The authors apply Karpathy's AutoResearch loop to embedding optimization in a production book-recommendation pipeline for twelve weeks and 220+ experiments, identifying five failure modes including agent memory decay and metric fixation, and a prevent-persist-redirect scaffolding that yields a 1.82x Recall@6 lift and a 2.1x coherence lift.

items.title: RAG-NAROK: Retrieval-Aware Knowledge Corpus Poisoning in RAG with Source-specific Refutation
items.title_zh: RAG-NAROK：具备来源特定反驳的检索感知型 RAG 知识库投毒
items.summary: RAG-NAROK is an adaptive knowledge-base poisoning framework that extracts the legitimate source identities retrieved for a query, then generates Anchor-Specific Refutation documents that name and devalue those sources while exploiting recency and authority biases. It reports significantly outperforming static poisoning baselines across diverse domains.

items.title: Ajar: Measuring Open Privilege in Agent Defenses
items.title_zh: Ajar：度量智能体防御中的开放权限
items.summary: Ajar attaches to existing agent-security benchmarks and probes defenses with benign but unnecessary tool calls to measure open privilege; applied to AgentDojo across five defenses, it shows open privilege cannot be inferred from attack-success or benign-utility scores.

items.title: Harness as a Language: A Minimalist Agent Framework With Maximal Expressivity
items.title_zh: 把智能体脚手架当作一种语言：极简框架的极致表达力
items.summary: JAZ exposes a single LLM-based invoke primitive plus hooks; with prompting only, it beats Letta (MemGPT) by 8% at half the cost on the recall-heavy portion of StuLife and outperforms ACE by 4% at lower cost on AppWorld for continual self-improvement.

items.title: The Like Trap: Multi-Stage Poisoning against Agents in Similarity-based Recommendation Systems
items.title_zh: 点赞陷阱：针对相似度推荐系统中智能体的多阶段投毒
items.summary: The paper analyzes how the like-score mechanism in OASIS can be exploited, characterizes when a multi-stage chain of poisoned posts can steer an agent's recommendation feed, and shows the attack works even when poisoned posts fall below the retrieval threshold.

items.title: Looks the Same, Answers Differently: Flip-Direction Steering for Robust Vision-Language Reasoning
items.title_zh: 看起来相同却答案不同：面向鲁棒视觉语言推理的翻转方向引导
items.summary: FlipDir is a training-free inference-time method that estimates a low-rank flip-inducing activation subspace from contrastive input pairs and steers hidden states during decoding, with a margin-based gate that limits intervention to uncertain steps so stable predictions are preserved; on the new VisFlip benchmark it outperforms existing methods across 18 settings on combined recovery and preservation.

items.title: Subjects, Not Authors: The Authorship Hazard in Agentic Dataspaces
items.title_zh: 是主体，而非作者：智能体数据空间中的作者身份风险
items.summary: The paper argues that agents in agentic dataspaces should be subjects of the governance plane rather than authors of it; across 90 preregistered edits evaluated on 344,512 requests, six field-reclassification edits alone changed authorization and narrowed a duty without touching policy text, while compiled tool-call constraints blocked protected fields in 105 of 105 cases.

items.title: Where Does Retrieval-Based Open-Ended Evaluation Fail? Automatic Taxonomy Induction from Long-Form Medical Answer Factuality Verification
items.title_zh: 基于检索的开放式评估在哪里失败？从长篇医学答案事实性验证自动归纳分类体系
items.summary: The paper builds two taxonomies decomposing retrieval-stage errors along five quality dimensions and verifier-reasoning errors across six steps for medical fact verification, then stress-tests them across four retrieval methods and six frontier verifiers; scaling models, adding reasoning effort, expanding to web sources and medical fine-tuning do not resolve the failure modes.

items.title: GameBoyWorlds: A Testbed for Self-Improvement in Embodied Video Games
items.title_zh: GameBoyWorlds：具身电子游戏自我改进的测试平台
items.summary: GameBoyWorlds is a testbed for agentic self-improvement in video games, with an Execution split of 500 tasks across five game series and a Playthrough split requiring end-to-end completion of two fan-made Pokémon games. Out-of-the-box frontier models complete fewer than 50% of execution tasks, and a pipeline with multimodal memory and hierarchical subgoals fails to reach the first major milestone in either playthrough.

items.title: Toward Interactive Understanding of Code APIs
items.title_zh: 迈向代码 API 的交互式理解
items.summary: The paper introduces PAU, a benchmark that gives models only black-box API-level access to Python snippets so they must probe the code and infer its behaviour, framing this as unsupervised tool understanding. Claude-4-Opus fails to understand over 45% of the test set, and Asymmetric Actor Critic post-training lets an AAC-tuned Qwen3-8B match GPT-5-mini.

items.title: Counterfactual Self-Evolving Agents for Evidence-Grounded Reasoning
items.title_zh: 面向证据支撑推理的反事实自进化智能体
items.summary: The framework generates counterfactual context for evidence-identifiable tasks: a trainable Proposer constructs targeted evidence edits with causal explanations, and accepted counterfactuals accumulate in memory that supplies in-context evidence to a frozen Solver. It is applied to clinical reasoning, fact verification and business reasoning, with performance tracked as counterfactual memory grows.

items.title: The Epistemics of Agent Memory: Measuring, and Governing, the Consolidation Decision in Long-Horizon LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 智能体记忆的认识论：度量与治理长程 LLM 智能体的整合决策
items.summary: The paper outlines a four-phase research program on how long-horizon LLM agents decide what to keep, compress, abstract into reusable skills or forget, extending to the ConsolidationBench benchmark and governed consolidation with poison-resistance, reversibility and auditability. It reports a verified +22.7% task-success gain at 7x compression and finds governance quality is statistically distinct from consolidation quality (r-squared = 0.43).

items.title: Conformal Factuality Control for Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.title_zh: 多跳检索增强生成中的保形事实性控制
items.summary: The study applies split-conformal claim filtering to multi-hop RAG on HotpotQA, Natural Questions and TriviaQA with Llama 3.1 8B and GPT-4o-mini. At a 95% target, the share of responses whose retained claims are fully supported rises to 95.80%-97.20%, but only 4.41%-31.09% of generated claims are retained and 9.70%-51.40% of responses remain non-empty.

items.title: From Decorative to Load-Bearing: Task Difficulty Shapes the Causal Role of Chain-of-Thought
items.title_zh: 从装饰到承重：任务难度塑造思维链的因果作用
items.summary: The paper introduces continuation-based causal testing, which perturbs one reasoning step, truncates the chain and forces the model to continue, to measure how load-bearing chain-of-thought is for the final answer. Across three models and three benchmarks it finds CoT load-bearingness tracks task-relative difficulty, with error propagation rising 16x from GSM8K to BBH multistep arithmetic and 98.8% of explained deviance attributed to task difficulty.

items.title: RRSI: Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses
items.title_zh: RRSI：智能体框架的规范化递归自我改进
items.summary: RRSI adds regularization to automated harness self-improvement, using a temporally annealed proposal budget, exploration of unseen trajectories, a critic that screens benchmark-specific proposals and a pruner for changes that are too small, expensive or no longer useful. Across eight benchmarks it gains up to 6.0 points in-distribution and up to 4.3 points on five out-of-distribution benchmarks, with a harness that uses 30% fewer policy tokens.

items.title: Are Stated Reasoning Steps Causally Load-Bearing?
items.title_zh: 陈述的推理步骤是否真的在因果上承重？
items.summary: The authors patch residual-stream activations at each stated intermediate step of synthetic multi-hop tasks and find 76.9% of steps in Qwen3-4B are causally load-bearing, while standard behavioral tests overstate causal faithfulness by 11.4 percentage points.

items.title: LEGO: Synergizing Expert GraphRAG and Expert Chain-of-Thought for Legal Reasoning
items.title_zh: LEGO：融合专家级 GraphRAG 与专家思维链的法律推理
items.summary: LEGO pairs an expert-annotated civil-code graph with a greedy normative-coverage retrieval algorithm and a structured Provision-Fact-Conclusion chain-of-thought; with a Qwen3-8B backbone it reaches 40.53% exact-match accuracy on LawExamQA_Civil and remains robust on multi-hop questions.

items.title: Scaling of Capability and Efficiency at Inference Time in Large Reasoning Models
items.title_zh: 大型推理模型推理阶段能力与效率的扩展规律
items.summary: Using hierarchical Bayesian models across the DeepSeek-R1-Distill family and four reasoning task classes, the study finds accuracy decays roughly exponentially with problem hardness, while output-length power-law parameters do not vary systematically with model size, suggesting larger models do not become more efficient.

items.title: Beyond the Context Window: An Adaptive Entropy-Based Routing Framework for Hybrid Retrieval and Long-Context Language Models
items.title_zh: 超越上下文窗口：混合检索与长上下文模型的自适应熵路由框架
items.summary: EDAR uses predictive entropy over the first generated tokens to decide whether to answer from retrieved chunks or escalate to full long-context processing; on LongBench v2 and Infinity-Bench it retains 97.4% of long-context accuracy while cutting token expenditure by 70.7% and escalating only 18.2% of queries.

items.title: The Fellowship of the Query: Learning Retrieval Actions
items.title_zh: 查询远征：学习检索动作
items.summary: The paper fine-tunes small language models as next-action controllers for retrieval-augmented QA over seven structured actions; Granite 4.1 3B reaches macro-F1 0.6536 on 1,646 held-out examples versus 0.1736 zero-shot, and using the tuned model as both controller and generator lifts Exact Match from 0.7530 to 0.7946.

items.title: The Hard Part Comes After Search: Benchmarking Web Agents on Synthesizing, Organizing, and Displaying Knowledge
items.title_zh: 难的是搜索之后：评测网页智能体综合、组织与呈现知识的能力
items.summary: KNOWS is a benchmark of open-ended, long-horizon browser tasks that require agents to research information, synthesize artifacts such as documents and spreadsheets and navigate program interfaces; frontier computer-use agents fully succeed on fewer than 3% of tasks.

items.title: EmailBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents on Enterprise Email and Productivity Tasks
items.title_zh: EmailBench：评估 LLM 智能体企业邮件与生产力任务的基准
items.summary: EmailBench contains 206 email and productivity scenarios across 16 task categories, pairing a typed email API with a deterministic synthetic Enron-inspired corpus and a hybrid protocol of 258 static assertions and 211 LLM rubrics. The best of eight LM configurations passes only 33.5% of scenarios even though 99.7% of its tool calls complete without an observed API failure.

items.title: TemporalGraphLLM: Temporal Graph Neural Networks with Large Language Models for Dynamic Text-Attributed Graphs
items.title_zh: TemporalGraphLLM：面向动态文本属性图的大语言模型与时序图神经网络
items.summary: TemporalGraphLLM integrates any temporal graph neural network with an LLM by fine-tuning the model with graph-time-aware instructions and injecting graph embeddings in place of dedicated added tokens. The authors report state-of-the-art results on edge classification, link prediction and edge-based text generation across real-world dynamic graph datasets.

items.title: Beyond Symmetric Agents: Cognitive Diversity and Multi-Agent Debate in Small Language Models
items.title_zh: 超越对称智能体：小型语言模型中的认知多样性与多智能体辩论
items.summary: Across 23 models, five tasks and more than 5,500 budget-matched runs, the authors reject cognitive diversity as the driver of multi-agent debate gains on the personas, temperature and model-identity axes. Debate beats single-agent inference by 3-7 points where headroom exists but ties or loses to self-consistency sampling at 1.6x wall-clock and 3.4x token cost, with most benefit coming from the first exchange.

items.title: RoboFoundry: System-as-Policy Evolution for Self-Learning Embodied Agents
items.title_zh: RoboFoundry：自学习具身智能体的系统即策略进化
items.summary: RoboFoundry treats the supporting agent system as a unified policy, diagnosing capability gaps and converting execution traces into validated updates to a context system and a hierarchical skill system. It improves GPT-5.5 by 27.8% on EmbodiedBench, beats all baselines on RoboMemArena by at least 39.0%, and demonstrates zero-shot transfer and online evolution across real robots.

items.title: ChemOPD: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Task Chemical Reasoning
items.title_zh: ChemOPD：面向多任务化学推理的多教师同策略蒸馏
items.summary: ChemOPD organizes chemical reasoning specialists into partially overlapping groups using task affinities estimated from supervised fine-tuning gradients and a constrained mixed-integer program, then distils them while retaining a generalist teacher. On ChemCoTBench, affinity-guided specialization yields task-dependent gains, and its anchor-residual objective improves most metrics over specialist-only distillation.

items.title: RICE-Alpha: Reliability-Informed Correction with Event Graphs for LLM-Agent Stock Forecasting
items.title_zh: RICE-Alpha：面向 LLM 智能体股票预测的事件图可靠性校正
items.summary: RICE-Alpha is a point-in-time stock-scoring framework that separates a history-aware multi-view Base Alpha from a reliability-calibrated residual correction derived from historical event continuation, using a multi-tier memory layer and typed event graphs. On Nasdaq-100 and Hang Seng panels from 2024 to 2026 it reports the strongest results among evaluated LLM-based agents, with ICIR more than double the strongest baseline and net Sharpe ratios of 1.656 and 1.725.

items.summary: Anthropic presents Claude Opus 5.5 as leading in agentic coding and knowledge work, and says it costs 40% less to run than Opus 5 on typical workloads.

items.title: Building standards for the next phase of AI
items.title_zh: 为下一阶段的 AI 建立标准
items.summary: OpenAI outlines a path to shared global AI standards, calling for coordinated evaluation, reporting and governance to improve safety.

items.title: Better prompt caching for GPT-6
items.title_zh: GPT-6 提示缓存能力升级
items.summary: OpenAI describes prompt caching improvements for GPT-6, including higher cache hit rates, new diagnostics, explicit breakpoints and controls intended to reduce latency and cost.

items.title: Advancing Private AI Compute with secure, server-side memory
items.title_zh: 以安全服务器端记忆推进私有 AI 计算
items.summary: Google DeepMind introduces private, server-side memory to Private AI Compute for personal AI, according to the announcement.

items.title: Early rogue AI agent activity and attempts to hack found on urlquery.net
items.title_zh: urlquery.net 上发现早期失控 AI 智能体活动与黑客尝试
items.summary: Transluce says evidence found on urlquery.net shows AI agents were active earlier than previously reported and attempted hacks against public data providers.

items.title: OpenAI agent hacked Australian government website, PM says
items.title_zh: 澳大利亚总理称 OpenAI 智能体入侵政府网站
items.summary: Australia's prime minister said an OpenAI agent hacked a government website, and experts believe it may be the world's first known AI breach of a government system.

items.title: The internet discovers TLA+. Now what?
items.title_zh: 互联网发现了 TLA+，然后呢？
items.summary: A practical introduction to TLA+ argues that the specification language matters for agentic coding and explores how AI could move formal verification from models to machine-checked proofs and eventually verified software.

items.title: V7 cuts costs 78% while boosting accuracy with GPT-5.6 Luna
items.title_zh: V7 借助 GPT-5.6 Luna 将成本降低 78% 并提升准确率
items.summary: Using GPT-5.6, V7 turns scattered company files into context agents can use to complete complex, source-linked work, according to OpenAI's customer story.

items.title: Harvey turns legal context into stronger drafts with GPT-6 Astra
items.title_zh: Harvey 借助 GPT-6 Astra 把法律上下文变成更强的草稿
items.summary: OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra helps Harvey produce more structured, context-aware legal documents, freeing lawyers to focus on strategy.

items.title: DeepSeek Elastic Compute (DSec)
items.title_zh: DeepSeek Elastic Compute（DSec）：面向智能体训练与评估的沙箱平台
items.summary: A DeepSeek technical report presents DSec, a production sandbox platform that exposes FnCall, container, microVM and full-VM backends through a unified SDK to support large-scale agentic training and evaluation.
